entries.f364c242e8ef7916: Under the corporate philosophy “Creating together, communicating together,” the company works on “restructuring of its business” and “improvement of earnings capacity,” and envisions a V-shaped recovery aimed at a fundamental strengthening of earnings capacity and firmly establishing a continuing profit base. In the Printing Business, the company is continuing price-adjustment negotiations with customers and reviewing unprofitable transactions, consolidating bases at the Sayama Plant to raise the in-house production ratio, and expanding sales of high value-added products in which it takes part from the planning and production stages. It states that it will commit management resources to the packaging materials and packaging field for pharmaceuticals and OTC products handled by consolidated subsidiary Shinmura Insatsu Co., Ltd., as a growth area. In the industrial materials and electronic component manufacturing business, the company will expand applications in medical and healthcare and industrial sensors. In newspaper printing, it will shift to an asset-light collaborative structure. It states it will also pursue expanded sales of paper-based flexible packaging and a review of its real estate leasing and other businesses.
